Warlocks are the ultimate form of the Mage path and the most complex class in the entire Magic system. They combine absolute mastery of the four Elements with the secrets of Soul Buster. A Warlock can weave the four Elements into an Entrapping Net or crush a single target through sheer force of will with Soul Buster.

These magic experts own overwhelming magic potential already, but now their magics are at a complete different level: they are capable of wielding the power of Neutral magics, or even utilizing their Psychokinesis power to control gravity.

Capable of using more powerful magics. Although their poor close-quarter combat ability being their weakness as past, by mastering the four elemental stats of Water, Earth, Fire, and Air, they can still be a powerful addition to the team with their incredibly wide-range AOE magics.
Excels at long-range magical combat and can command the five elements of Water, Fire, Wind, Earth, and Ghost.

When an Assassin Cross achieves a Breakthrough beyond their limits, they become the dreaded Guillotine Cross. Each ring of violet-black afterimages is a waltz that reaps Life—a devastating display of Ultra speed.

An assassin who always has another trick under their sleeve, and none of their targets ever live to see another day. They're good at using poison and assassin techniques to sabotage the enemy's formation and achieve effective results.

Agile, swift, and deadly, Assassins learn the ways of the Dual Blade Technique. Their unrivaled burst damage makes them rulers of one-on-one combat. They can equip the Katar, a weapon with a high critical rate.
Thief is the most agile of all Adventurer classes. Rather than relying on heavy armor to survive, Thieves use their extraordinary reflexes to evade attacks.

The kingdom's mightiest knight, having mastered the power of runes and tamed a demonic dragon. With complete mastery of swords and spears, Rune Knights ride demonic dragons into the fray, unleash elemental breath attacks, and Sweep Attack entire armies.

Their stopping power is enough to crush frontline enemies in the blink of an eye, and they are the most powerful force of The Knights. Not only do they excel in both offensive and defensive positions, once they are in rampage, they're able to massively increase their physique within a short amount of time.
A loyal knight of the kingdom. Skilled with swords and spears, knights can ride Peco Pecos into battle, wield formidable offensive power, and rapidly charge toward enemies.
Excels at close-range combat, wielding a sword with a balance of offense and defense.

A solitary Ranger who keeps only a Demonic Wolf for company and has mastered the art of marksmanship. The Ranger can unleash rapid shots at distant targets with the speed of a gale or ride a Demonic Wolf for highly mobile hunts.
They are shooters with perfect aim. Under the attack of arrows and their falcons, no enemy can withstand long, not to mention to fight back.

Long-range combat specialist, master of archery, and a mastermind who utilizes traps to lure the enemy into the palm of their hand. They can train a Falcon to support them, and the upper limit to their attack damage is very high.
Uses a bow to excel at ranged attacks and can knock enemies back at critical moments.

The ultimate evolution of the Crusader path. Royal Guards are not only the kingdom's mightiest warriors, but also engines of destruction that shatter enemy lines. They can withstand and deal heavy damage, crash repeatedly through enemy formations, or serve as the core of their own party.
Tempered by even greater holy trials, Paladins Enhance the core mechanics of each Crusader path, further defining the class traits of the "Attacker" and "Protector."

Warriors who walk the path of holy war, wielding faith and Spear as their sharpest weapons. After Job Advance from Swordsman, Crusaders Keep their formidable melee capabilities while further specializing in Spear weapons. They develop two distinct combat styles: an Attack-type Spear build that trades blood for damage, and a defensive shield build that protects allies in peril.

Piloting the Madogear Pilot, they Launch long-range cannon fire to demolish enemy lines, or charge in with a kinetic battle axe to control the field and unleash explosive strikes, leaving opponents no time to breathe.
Skill elevated to an art, craftsmanship without limit. A Blacksmith at the pinnacle of the craft wields peerless hands to push forging power to its utmost.
Flame and hammer define a Blacksmith's life—the power of tempering not only forges keen blades, but also empowers the party to Sweep Attack through enemy lines.
Excels at healing allies and specializes in defensive and buff magic.
